camera: Flat front-facing UI, no 3D previews or parallax.

hudLayout.topThird: Top-left: tilted brown leather chapter book with gold '1' and 'CHAPTER'. Top-right: grey header strip with three dark grey counter slots: hexagonal gold coin 0, green star 0, magenta meeple 126; below them a segmented quest bar with 4 segments, the first partly grey-filled, and '0/4' in amber at the right. Under the header a dark wood plank band holding a rolled parchment quest scroll with a red wax seal centred. At ~16-20% a khaki title bar spanning full width with 'SETTINGS' in dark khaki bold text at left and a crimson square close button 'X' at right. Under it at ~21-26% a wide teal chunky button 'hold to reset progress' centred.
hudLayout.middleThird: Below the button the settings sheet is pure black empty space down to ~44%. At ~44-55% a confirmation popup: dark charcoal framed panel ~80% of width, an amber/yellow title bar 'Reset all progress?' in white bold, below it a grey body panel 'Your heroes, resources and map progress will be wiped. This cannot be undone.'. Directly below at ~57%: lime-olive 'YES' button left and crimson 'NO' button right.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Black empty space down to ~94%. Bottom strip: dark wood plank band with a steel-blue cog settings button at bottom-right; debug text 'fps: 60.02' bottom-left and 'username' bottom-centre. The whole screen behind the popup is dimmed.

keyElements: chapter book, counters (coin 0, star 0, meeple 126) and 0/4 quest bar header
khaki 'SETTINGS' title bar with crimson 'X' close button
dark confirm popup with yellow title 'Reset all progress?' and grey message panel
wood bottom bar with cog bottom-right
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice buttons (teal, lime, crimson, crimson square X) with rounded rims and darker front lips; flat khaki title strip; flat charcoal popup frame with a flat yellow title strip and flat grey body; large unstyled black background.
colorPalette: Mostly black, with a warm brown and khaki band at the top, saturated jewel accents on buttons and a bright yellow popup title in the middle.
mood: Serious and final — a warning before wiping the adventure.
composition: Header and settings title anchor the top; the popup and its YES/NO pair are the brightest block at mid-screen; the rest is empty.

header.questScroll: rolled parchment with red wax seal

popup.title: Reset all progress?
popup.body: Your heroes, resources and map progress will be wiped. This cannot be undone.
